description: Returns the current state of a render: status (queued, rendering, succeeded or failed), download_url with expires_at, page_count, units and error, and the picture of a finished image render up to 2 MB. Use it to follow a render started with wait false, or to get a fresh link once the old one has expired; render and convert_to_pdf already return this for the render they just made. Read-only and free; an unknown id returns an error.

id.description: rnd_ id of the render, as render or convert_to_pdf returned it

name: get_render

accessibility.description: The PDF/UA-1 verdict, when the template declares it

download_url.description: Signed link to the file; null until the render succeeded

einvoice.description: The e-invoice report, when the render made one

expires_at.description: When download_url stops working; get_render issues a fresh one

template.description: The template and version rendered; null for html and conversions

title: Get a render
